name: debugbundle
description: Connect Claude Code to DebugBundle MCP tools for production incident debugging, bundles, reproductions, health checks, probes, alerts, and verification.

member_token.title: DebugBundle member token
member_token.description: Optional. Use a DebugBundle member token for Claude Code MCP read and management tools. Leave blank to use local DebugBundle CLI auth state.

api_url.title: DebugBundle API URL
api_url.description: Optional. Leave blank for DebugBundle Cloud. Set only for self-hosted or non-default API hosts.
